headline: Quantum computing start-up Taiyi Quantum has raised more than $140 million in eight months to build quantum computers from individual atoms, Dealroom reports.
score_reason: Only the headline could be read, so the amount and timing are unverified.
importance_line: It points to strong private funding for atom-based quantum computing, but the total and its rounds are unverified because the article could not be read.
summary: Dealroom reports that Taiyi Quantum, a start-up working on quantum computers based on individual atoms, has raised more than $140 million over eight months.
notes: Headline only; Dealroom page blocked (403) and no other outlet carries the new total. Earlier coverage seen in Google News (300 million yuan Pre-A in June 2026, $42 million in July 2026) was not used as fact.
